edges.reason: _to is used as the key for limitsPerAddress in mint.
_amount is used in _amount * NFT_PRICE and numTokens + _amount arithmetic.
_to is used as the key for limitsPerAddress in mintOwner.
_amount is used in numTokens + _amount and limit.tokens + _amount arithmetic.
_to is the arbitrary recipient of the low-level ETH call.
_amount is the ETH value forwarded by the low-level call.
withdraw executes the low-level call transferring ETH to _to.
Recipient of the call can re-enter withdraw before state is finalized.
_owner is checked by onlyOwner to gate withdraw.
_msgSender() (msg.sender) is compared to owner() in onlyOwner.
msg.sender is hashed into the pseudo-random index entropy.
block.timestamp > START_TIME gates execution of mint.
START_TIME is compared against block.timestamp in mint.
block.timestamp is used as entropy for randomIndex, making ids timestamp dependent.
nonce participates in the keccak256 entropy and is incremented in randomIndex.
indices array is read and written during the swap in randomIndex.
numTokens is used to compute totalSize = TOKEN_LIMIT - numTokens.
numTokens + _amount is checked against TOKEN_LIMIT and incremented per minted token.
TOKEN_LIMIT bounds the numTokens + _amount addition check.
NFT_PRICE is multiplied by _amount for the msg.value requirement.
limitsPerAddress is read and updated in mint.
randomIndex returns newTokenId consumed by mint.
newTokenId local is used in the _safeMint call and Minted event.
newTokenId is passed to the receiver callback during _safeMint.
The ERC721 receiver callback executes external code while mint state is in flight.
Local limit struct is written back to limitsPerAddress in mint.
Local limit is read from limitsPerAddress in mint.
limitsPerAddress is read and updated in mintOwner.
mintOwner calls _safeMint which triggers the receiver callback.
_tokenId is validated and encoded into the token URI string.
index local is computed and used for array access in randomIndex.
value local is resolved and incremented before being returned.
